changelog: New: Strategy Lab — create unlimited custom strategies, each with up to 5 user-defined variables (checkbox, 1-5 scale, dropdown, or short text)
New additive schema: strategies, strategy_variables, trade_variables tables
Additive trade columns reserved for Wave 2 (strategy_id, emotion_tag, setup_grade, note_saw, note_why, note_unsure)
Additive challenges.default_strategy_id for hybrid challenge-strategy linking
Foundation only — trade form and review engine are unchanged this release

db_migrations.name: create_strategies_table
db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS strategies (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, is_active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, KEY idx_user (user_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

db_migrations.name: create_strategy_variables_table
db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS strategy_variables (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, strategy_id INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, input_type ENUM('checkbox','scale','select','text') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'checkbox', options VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, sort_order TINYINT DEFAULT 0, KEY idx_strategy (strategy_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

db_migrations.name: create_trade_variables_table
db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trade_variables (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, trade_id INT NOT NULL, variable_id INT NOT NULL, value VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL, KEY idx_trade (trade_id), KEY idx_variable (variable_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
